main_text.p: sceretur, non pertinent ad legem Velleam. Sed ex sententia legis Velleae & haec omnia admittenda sunt, ut ad similitudinem mortis ceteri casus admittendi sint. Quid si qui filium apud hostes habebat, testaretur? quare non induxere, ut si anteaquam fi-lius ab hostibus rediret, quã-uis post mortem patris, decederet: tunc deinde nepos, uel etiam adhuc illis uiuis, post mortem scilicetaui nascetur, non rumperet? nam hic casus ad legem Velleam non pertinet. melius ergo est, ut in eiusmodiutili-tates. utilitate, praefertim post legem Velleam, quę

page.notes: The marginal quotation signs («) at the line ends of the text column are printed marks and are not transcribed. The right-hand notes are: "aui" beside "scilicet", "qui." beside the line "tur, non rumperet", and "utili- tates." beside "utilitate". The "qui." note is printed with a dot after it and is placed beside the line where the asterisk-mark is shown, so its exact attachment is uncertain. The word "quã-" is printed with a tilde over a; kept as printed. The fragment "o &" below the text is small and its meaning is unclear; it is kept as printed. The line "tim post legem" printed at the bottom of the column begins with "tim" and is part of "praefertim", which runs over the line end.
